kpis.name: Open backlog
kpis.definition: Requests created on or before the analysis date that do not have a valid closed timestamp on or before that date.
kpis.formula: count(created_at <= analysis_date AND (closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at > analysis_date))
kpis.target: Stable or declining unless demand growth is planned
kpis.limitations: Historical backlog is reconstructed from created and closed timestamps because intermediate status history is not present.

kpis.name: SLA attainment
kpis.definition: Share of trusted closed requests completed within their stated service-level target.
kpis.limitations: Excludes quarantined rows and does not adjust targets for customer-requested pauses.

kpis.name: Median resolution time
kpis.definition: Median elapsed resolution hours across trusted closed requests.
kpis.target: Trend downward while SLA attainment remains healthy
kpis.limitations: Resolution hours are supplied by the source system; paused time is not separately modeled.

kpis.name: Reopen rate
kpis.definition: Share of trusted closed requests marked as reopened.
kpis.limitations: The source contains a final reopened indicator rather than full reopen-event history.

kpis.name: Customer satisfaction
kpis.definition: Mean valid satisfaction score among trusted records with survey responses.
kpis.limitations: Survey non-response can create selection bias.

kpis.name: Data-quality score
kpis.definition: Weighted defect score across documented completeness, validity, uniqueness, consistency, and timeliness rules.
kpis.limitations: A high score means the documented rules passed; it does not prove business correctness beyond those rules.
